study_note.label: Opening study notes only: a short excerpt from Ḍalhaṇa’s invocation, original English study explanations, and selected glossary terms. The rest of the chapter remains source-only.

invocation.commentary_sanskrit:
सहस्राक्षं गणाधीशं स्वगुरुं च सरस्वतीम् ।
जनकं जनयित्रीं च शास्त्रादौ प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥
invocation.commentary_en: At the outset of his work, the commentator offers homage to the thousand-eyed one, the lord of the hosts, his own teacher, Sarasvatī, and both his parents.

key_terms.definition: At the beginning of the treatise.

Su.1.1.1.translation_en: We shall now explain the chapter on the origin of the Veda.

key_terms.definition: The arising or origin of the Veda; the opening names the subject of this chapter.
A chapter or lesson in a treatise.
‘We shall explain,’ the opening declaration of what follows.

Su.1.1.2.translation_en: As the venerable Dhanvantari taught it.

key_terms.definition: The teacher to whom the opening attributes the exposition.
‘Said’ or ‘spoke’; part of the compound form yathovāca, ‘as [he] spoke.’
